name: Kurinnaxx
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/ruins-of-ahnqiraj/kurinnaxx.md (no Classic Era HP was readable; the SoM figure 1,165,850 is not used because the boss's HP here is a fixed clock). ESTIMATES: the Scarab Terrace is drawn as a 45 yd sand circle with a southern approach (not measured). The fight is 150 s (70% in 105 s, Frenzy for the last 45 s; research only says 2-4 min, no log was readable). Mortal Wound lands every 9 s (middle of the emulators' 8-10 s, first at 8 s) on the tank only (a single-target melee debuff), -10% healing per stack for 15 s refreshing, stacks to 10. UNVERIFIED: the 15 s duration follows the BigWigs and DBM target bars and the wiki, while Wowhead Classic's spell page shows 30 s. Boss melee (700 per 2 s) is scaled with Wide Slash so a 10,000 HP tank survives with the raid's passive healing and dies inside a phase if a player healer ignores it (`healPerSecondWithPlayerHealer` 150, reduced further by Mortal Wound); Thrash (2 extra swings) is folded into the melee number. Wide Slash 1,100 every 13.5 s (emulators 12-15 s; a Wowhead comment reports 800-1,200 on a tank), 10 yd past the hitbox as a 120 degree frontal cone; the real cone is 'his front', the 120 is a placeholder. Frenzy at 30% is `enrage` with +90% melee (research: 900 to about 2,000 per hit, +250 flat and +75% haste, which the engine's single multiplier approximates; it never expires, matching 'until he dies'). APPROXIMATIONS of the two-tank swap. The sim has one tank player, so the swap is the `swapOut` `targetSwitch` on a fixed cadence (first at 36.5 s, then every 50 s, so at about the fourth stack; DBM and BigWigs flag 5 stacks and the guides range 3-6). The other tank is the 'raid' target for 15.5 s; Kurinnaxx is `boss.stationary: true` with `turnRate: 0`, fixed in place facing north, so he does not walk off to or turn on the raid anchor during that window (the real one is draggable and faces his target, so the tank cannot mis-face him here and facing is not a skill in this script, and the tip about moving him a few yards off a Sand Trap is not modelled). During those 15.5 s he hits nobody and the raid's damage on him continues, whereas in the real fight the second tank is taking the same hits. A `restWindow` debuff with `forbidAbilities` (and `breakMetric` `tauntedTooSoon`) blocks Taunt for 15.5 s: pressing it early is scored and is the actual mistake (your stacks are still ticking). Mortal Wound is `conditional: onPlayer`, so it stops while the other tank has him and your stacks fall off 15 s after the last hit, exactly as in the real fight. Nothing prevents the stacks from ticking up on the player when the tank Taunts straight back; they just never reset, which the healer-side `healingMult` and the player's own reduced regen punish. Stack-count-driven swaps are not supported; the cadence is the proxy, and stack count is what the player sees. Other approximations: Sand Trap is a `hazard` under random players (cooldown 8 s, observed by BigWigs and DBM; 4.5 s warning, middle of 4-5 s; 2,000 damage, middle of 1,750-2,250; 8 yd radius) that `applies` its real 20 s Silence (`sandTrapSilence`) to the healer role only, because Silence does not stop a wand, an Auto Shot or melee and `forbidAbilities` scores every press; `castWhileSilenced` scores each press under it. The -75% melee and ranged hit on physical attackers has no engine equivalent and is not modelled. Being caught is also scored by the heavy `playerInHazard` penalty. Summon Player has no live source and is omitted. Warcraft Tavern's 'flying adds' are almost certainly trash and are not modelled. No dispels exist in this fight (Mortal Wound and Sand Trap have no dispel type), so the healer has no Dispel button. Threat is a placeholder (70 per second ghost tank); nothing in the research requires a threat scoring here beyond the normal rules.

labels.text: Open sand: Kurinnaxx here, facing north
Raid, spread: no two in one ring

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: You and the other warrior trade him. Stay north of him. At around four or five stacks of Mortal Wound the other tank Taunts: do not fight it. Step off, let the 15 s run out so your stacks fall, then Taunt him back the moment you are clean. Never Taunt early: he keeps stacking you. Frenzy at 30% about doubles his hits.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay behind him or on his flank, never in his front: Wide Slash hits whoever is in his front. Mortal Wound is on the tank only. Leave a sand ring the moment it appears under you.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Spread around him so one 8 yd ring catches only you. Leave a sand ring within its 4 to 5 seconds, then get back to work. Nothing to interrupt or dispel.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Mortal Wound cuts healing by 10% per stack. Pre-cast ahead of Wide Slash and Thrash, and stay spread: a Silenced healer during Frenzy can lose the tank.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt him back when your stacks have fallen off. Never earlier.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls the boss off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A big heal on the tank. Have it landing as the spike hits, not after.

mortalWound.label: Mortal Wound
mortalWound.tip: -10% healing received per stack for 15 s, refreshed by every new one. It cannot be removed: only the swap clears it.

swapOut.label: Tank swap: other tank taunts
swapOut.toast: Tank swap: the other tank Taunted at your stacks. Step off and let them fall.
swapOut.tip: At around four or five Mortal Wounds the other tank takes him. Step out of the cone, wait 15 s for your stacks to drop, then Taunt him back.

restWindow.label: Waiting: your stacks are falling
restWindow.tip: You just swapped. Press nothing. Let the 15 s pass so your Mortal Wound stacks fall off, then Taunt.

wideSlash.label: Wide Slash
wideSlash.tip: His frontal cleave, 10 yd past his hitbox. Stay out of the front.

sandTrap.label: Sand Trap
sandTrap.tip: A ring of sand under a random player. It bursts after 4 to 5 seconds for 2,000 and a 20 s Silence. Leave it now.

sandTrapSilence.label: Sand Trap
sandTrapSilence.tip: Silenced for 20 s and -75% to hit. No spells until it ends.

frenzy.label: Frenzy
frenzy.toast: Frenzy: he hits twice as hard until he dies
frenzy.tip: At 30% he enrages for +75% attack speed and +250 damage per hit. It does not expire.

expectations.label: Stay north of him
expectations.tip: Taunt him and stay on his north side. He stands still here, so your only job is to be in place and do not stray.

expectations.label: Take him back when your stacks are gone
expectations.tip: The other tank has him at your stacks. Stay out of the cone, let the 15 s run out, then Taunt him back the moment you are clean.

expectations.label: Get out of the sand ring before it bursts
expectations.tip: The ring under your feet gives you 4 to 5 seconds. Leave it, then go back to work. A trap is 2,000 and 20 seconds of silence for anyone caught.

expectations.label: Spread out and watch your feet
expectations.tip: Spread so one ring cannot catch two of you. Watch the sand under your own feet.

expectations.label: Melee: never stand in his front
expectations.tip: Wide Slash hits whoever is in his front. Mortal Wound is on the tank only. Stay behind him or on his flank.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: When the threat bar is in the red band, stop attacking until the tank is clear again.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Mortal Wound cuts healing by 10% a stack. Get ahead of Wide Slash and Thrash.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Keep them above half. A Wide Slash and a Thrash land together.

expectations.label: Take him back when your stacks are gone
expectations.tip: The other tank has him at your stacks. Stay out of the cone, let the 15 s run out, then Taunt him back the moment you are clean.

expectations.label: Get out of the sand ring before it bursts
expectations.tip: The ring under your feet gives you 4 to 5 seconds. Leave it, then go back to work. A trap is 2,000 and 20 seconds of silence for anyone caught.

expectations.label: Spread out and watch your feet
expectations.tip: Spread so one ring cannot catch two of you. Watch the sand under your own feet.

expectations.label: Melee: never stand in his front
expectations.tip: Wide Slash hits whoever is in his front. Mortal Wound is on the tank only. Stay behind him or on his flank.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: When the threat bar is in the red band, stop attacking until the tank is clear again.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Frenzy. Every heal lands 10% weaker per stack. Everything on the tank.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Stay ahead: at 30% he hits about twice as hard.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or the boss is not on the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Nothing on the ground is worth a global. Step out, then carry on.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the spike.

castWhileSilenced.label: Pressed into Silence
castWhileSilenced.tip: A Sand Trap silenced you for 20 s. Press nothing until it ends.

tauntedTooSoon.label: Taunted before your stacks fell off
tauntedTooSoon.tip: Wait out the full 15 s after the swap. Pressing Taunt early is the mistake: you keep stacking.

cues.notes: Taunt back after a swap once the stacks have fallen; heal when the tank drops low.

list.label: Taunt him back: your stacks are gone
list.tip: Taunt the moment the wait ends. A late Taunt hands the off-tank two waves of stacks.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with Mortal Wound stacks is where tanks die. Heal now, and heal early next time.

drills.name: Stack count and swap
drills.description: Mortal Wound every 5 s and a swap every 30 s. Wait out the 15 s after each swap, then Taunt him back.

drills.name: Sand Trap footwork
drills.description: A ring every 7 s. Step out of each one before it bursts and go back to work.

drills.name: Stay out of his front
drills.description: Wide Slash every 6 s and a sand ring every 9 s: melee stay behind him and step out of the rings.

drills.name: Healing through Mortal Wound
drills.description: Stacks every 4 s with Wide Slash on top. Heal ahead of the spikes while each heal lands weaker.
